concerns.text: Tasks T014 and T015 implement 'raw metrics' (total_lines_changed, debt_score) and Semgrep, directly violating Spec FR-001/FR-002 (density metrics, SonarQube) and Constitution Principle VI (Metric Normalization). The Plan acknowledges this as a 'Methodological Correction' requiring a kickback, but the tasks proceed without the spec update, constituting a silent relaxation of the FRs.

Task T021 implements 'Meta-analysis of Fisher-transformed r' replacing the Spec FR-006 mandated 'Bonferroni correction'. This is a semantic weakening of the multiple-comparison constraint without a formal spec amendment or explicit 'staged' justification in the task description.

Task T013b attempts to satisfy SC-005 (tool validity) but the Plan explicitly admits the system 'does not independently verify the quality or validity' of citations. The task cannot satisfy the Success Criterion as written, creating a logical impossibility where the deliverable falls short of the SC it claims to satisfy.

Task T022 restricts sensitivity analysis thresholds to exactly '5, 10, 20'. Spec FR-008 requires re-running with 'thresholds of varying average LOC' to ensure robustness. Hardcoding three values narrows the scope of the required robustness check without explicit spec permission for staging.

Task T014 specifies 'Semgrep (latest stable version)' for debt calculation. Spec FR-002 mandates 'sonar-scanner CLI version 10.4 LTS'. Using a different tool and an unpinned version ('latest') violates Constitution Principle VII (Static Analysis Consistency) and the specific FR constraint.
